data.body:
Fixes #1466.

Backport alliedmodders/hl2sdk#438 onto the current SDK revision to restore the engine vtable layout without pulling in unrelated SDK API changes. This keeps client authorization working instead of disabling its callback.

Confirmed the same Windows crash locally: the old SteamID call returns AppID 730.

data.body:
CS2 1.41.9.2 (2026-10-22) added `IsSpawnGroupLoadedForClient( CPlayerSlot, SpawnGroupHandle_t )` to `IVEngineServer2`, right after `MakeSpawnGroupActive`. Every method after it moved down one slot, so plugins built against the current header call the neighbouring function: `GetClientXUID` lands on `GetPlayerInfo` and crashes the server.

Same change as alliedmodders/s2sdk#116.

Tested: CounterStrikeSharp 1.0.377, ServerListPlayersFix and cs2surf rebuilt against it, running on 5 servers since the update.
data.title: Add IVEngineServer2::IsSpawnGroupLoadedForClient

issue.title: [Bug]  fails to launch the game
issue.body:
### CS2 server operating system

Windows

### How is the CS2 game server hosted?

Listen server hosted by a CS2 client

### What happened?

When launching Counter-Strike 2 with the plugin enabled, the game begins starting normally. It gets past the Valve logo and reaches the Counter-Strike 2 logo, but then the game closes unexpectedly before reaching the main menu.

This issue does not occur when launching the game without the plugin enabled. The game launches successfully without the plugin.

Steps to reproduce:

Enable the plugin.

Launch Counter-Strike 2.

Wait for the game to get past the Valve logo and reach the Counter-Strike 2 logo.

Observe that the game closes before reaching the main menu.

Expected behavior: Counter-Strike 2 finishes launching and reaches the main menu.

Actual behavior: The game closes during startup at the Counter-Strike 2 logo.

Environment: Windows. The issue occurs when using the plugin.

### Does the problem also happen when CS2-Bot-Improver is disabled?

No, it only happens with CS2-Bot-Improver enabled

### CounterStrikeSharp log

_No response_

### Additional screenshots or video


After using the plugin to launch Counter-Strike 2, the game crashes during startup at the Counter-Strike 2 logo. After this happens, launching the game through the normal method does not work correctly until I verify the integrity of the game files through Steam.

Verifying the game files resolves the issue and allows the game to launch normally again through Steam. However, using the plugin to launch the game causes the problem to occur again.

This may be related to the plugin's interaction with the game files or launch process, but I have not confirmed the exact cause.
